1.web: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
1.asv: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

2.web: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before Yahweh.
2.asv: and he said unto Aaron, Take thee a calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering, without blemish, and offer them before Jehovah.

3.web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;
3.asv: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a he-goat for a sin-offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without blemish, for a burnt-offering;

4.web: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahweh; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today Yahweh appears to you.’”
4.asv: and an ox and a ram for peace-offerings, to sacrifice before Jehovah; and a meal-offering mingled with oil: for to-day Jehovah appeareth unto you.

5.web: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Yahweh.
5.asv: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tent of meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Jehovah.

6.web: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do: and Yahweh’s glory shall appear to you.”
6.asv: And Moses said, This is the thing which Jehovah commanded that ye should do: and the glory of Jehovah shall appear unto you.

7.web: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them; as Yahweh commanded.”
7.asv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Draw near unto the altar, and offer thy sin-offering, and thy burnt-offering, and make atonement for thyself, and for the people; and offer the oblation of the people, and make atonement for them; as Jehovah commanded.

8.web: So Aaron drew near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
8.asv: So Aaron drew near unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin-offering, which was for himself.

9.web: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:
9.asv: And the sons of Aaron presented the blood unto him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:

10.web: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
10.asv: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul from the liver of the sin-offering, he burnt upon the altar; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

11.web: The flesh and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.
11.asv: And the flesh and the skin he burnt with fire without the camp.

12.web: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
12.asv: And he slew the burnt-offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered unto him the blood, and he sprinkled it upon the altar round about.

13.web: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burned them upon the altar.
13.asv: And they delivered the burnt-offering unto him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.

14.web: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.
14.asv: And he washed the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt-offering on the altar.

15.web: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.
15.asv: And he presented the people’s oblation, and took the goat of the sin-offering which was for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

16.web: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
16.asv: And he presented the burnt-offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

17.web: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.
17.asv: And he presented the meal-offering, and filled his hand therefrom, and burnt it upon the altar, besides the burnt-offering of the morning.

18.web: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar,
18.asv: He slew also the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons delivered unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,

19.web: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver:
19.asv: and the fat of the ox and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul of the liver:

20.web: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar:
20.asv: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:

21.web: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.
21.asv: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave-offering before Jehovah; as Moses commanded.

22.web: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
22.asv: And Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin-offering, and the burnt-offering, and the peace-offerings.

23.web: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people: and Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the people.
23.asv: And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto all the people.

24.web: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
24.asv: And there came forth fire from before Jehovah, and consumed upon the altar the burnt-offering and the fat: and when all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
